title: Decoder round-trip under padding
statement: For every one-work-tape coded Turing machine $M$ and every natural number $m$, decoding the serialization of $M$ followed by $m$ additional $1$-bits returns $M$.
replaced:
For every coded machine $M$ and every $m \in \mathbb{N}$, the total decoder
maps the canonical serialization of $M$ followed by $m$ additional $1$-bits
back to $M$.
